scope: Training-only conditional kinematics fit followed by lens prediction
selection: Existing training role and release_use_flag=1; flagged galaxy retained as excluded with unresolved reason
model: Spherical Hernquist using prior pilot sizes; fixed empirical force and equal metric potentials
likelihood: Full released Gaussian covariance in Vrms, no extra scatter or lensing data in fit
refinement: 8001 radial nodes and 256 angular nodes at fitted parameters; no tuning based on lensing
limitations: No full source capture, independent stellar masses, shape or PSF marginalization, or calibrated confidence intervals
